original_clauses.source_paraphrase: Wuhan traffic police described a system failure affecting more than 100 Apollo Go vehicles in live traffic. Public evidence establishes correlated fleet-wide stoppage and passenger stranding but does not identify the failing component or control pathway.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A correlated fleet failure should leave enough evidence to determine whether required governance controls were available and whether operative control state survived the transition into failure.

original_clauses.source_paraphrase: The affected vehicles stopped rather than continuing autonomous driving through the system failure, and authorities reported that passengers exited safely with no injuries recorded.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: When continued objective pursuit is no longer safely supportable, the system should transition to a bounded stop rather than continue acting through an invalid or unsafe state.
